title: Early jobs and dance halls with Sam Morgan
summary: He lists halls played weekend nights, including Economy Hall on Mondays and the Saint Sue Hall on Howard, and talks about their present state.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I was going to ask some more about your days, early days before the war with Sam Morgan. Where you played, what kind of jobs you had in the beginning. Do you remember your very first job that you got paid for? Oh, around the city here?
Yeah. Well, oh yeah, we used to play at the Colony Hall. Where at? At the, the Hope's Hall. And at the Santa Teresa. Where was that?
I don't know that one.

That was up, up in the Gordon District. Or uptown. Mm-hmm. We used to play up, up there on a Saturday night, and play at Estore. Yeah, the hotel over on the drive-the-Range. Yeah. Played there on a Sunday night. Well, we had Saturday night, Sunday night, Monday night. That's about three to a week.
Where did you play Monday night?
Oh, we didn't do anything Monday night.
Oh, Monday, I thought. No. Somebody told me they used to have dances at the Economy Hall some night. Oh, yes, that's true.

At the Economy, was every Monday night. That was on Monday. Mm-hmm. That was, that would be Saturday, Sunday, and Monday. You mentioned Monday, then. You had to go to Monday. Yeah. And, at the Saint Sue Hall. That was up on Howard.
Oh, yeah. It's still there. Yeah. Yeah. Um, yeah.

I believe they have, uh, what's this boy's name? Around that, uh, place up there. It's a big nightclub he's got up there. Yeah. What is it there? That's near the Dutron. That's, that's the place. But I don't think it's the same building. No, it's just right in, it's in the same block. Yeah.
Is that the pool hall, did you say you were in that route one time? Uh, the old Saint Sue.
Yeah. Yeah, I think they have a pool hall in there now. Yeah, I think that's all connection to the one.
I don't know, I didn't notice that. You had to go through a courtyard and the dance hall was in back. Yeah. And the little sittin' back. That's right.
That's right. And the dance hall was in the back. Uh-huh. I went in there and it's just a pool hall now. Yeah.
You just have pool tables in there. I wouldn't know how it's located, you know. Mm-hmm.

Yeah. I don't know. I didn't notice that, you had to go through a courtyard and the dance hall was in back. Yeah. And the little sittin' back. That's right. That's right. And the dance hall was in the back. Uh-huh. I went in there and it's just a pool hall now. Yeah. You just have pool tables in there. I haven't been around that place in so long.
I wouldn't know how it's located, you know. It looked like a nice hall though, a nice big hall. Yeah. I thought one time the dude dropped was, I thought they was connected together.
The dude drops right on the street there, I think, on Howard.
Yes, it's on the front.
Right on the front. Mm-hmm. But it's up in the next building or something. Yeah. A little bit farther up top.
Mm-hmm.
